text: The applicant appealed its Zoning By-law Amendment and Official Plan Amendment applications to the Ontario Municipal Board, now the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (the "Tribunal"), on November 23, 2017 and February 2, 2018. Notwithstanding recent amendments to the Planning Act and their proclamation on April 3, 2018, the newly formed Local Planning Appeal Tribunal will maintain jurisdiction over the appeals according to the rules of the former Ontario Municipal Board. Further direction from City Council is required on this matter which has been appealed to the Tribunal.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 17, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (July 17, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 17, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
